UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile stored privately per user UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Login.

email.description: User email address (PII, restricted to owner only).

photoURL.description: Profile avatar URL from Google Login.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

DiagnosisCase.title: DiagnosisCase
DiagnosisCase.description: Saved problem diagnosis with root cause, action plan, and checklist progress.

id.description: Document ID of the saved diagnosis case.

problem.description: Original problem description submitted by the user.

caseTitle.description: Short diagnostic title for the problem.

engineMode.description: Engine used to generate the diagnosis.

rootCause.description: Direct explanation of what is causing the problem.

actionPlan.description: Ordered list of changes/steps to fix the problem (up to 8 steps).

completedStepIds.description: List of completed action step IDs (up to 8).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when case was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when case was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profiles isolated strictly to the owning authenticated user.

/cases/{caseId}.description: User-owned problem diagnosis dossiers and interactive checklist states.
